page.content:
White grape of Burgundy's Côte de Beaune, Chablis, and Champagne.

How Chardonnay connects

  • Item: Vitis vinifera — Chardonnay is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Location: Burgundy — Chardonnay is the white grape of Burgundy and Chablis.
  • Location: Champagne — Chardonnay is a pillar of Champagne blends and blanc de blancs.

What is Chardonnay?

Chardonnay takes oak or steel, butter or flint. It is the white half of Burgundy and the other half of many Champagne blends.

Key threads lead to Vitis vinifera, Burgundy and Champagne.
